scientific.integrity: The proof uses the source model, disease-free equilibrium, and endemic-equilibrium coefficients directly. A standalone exact-rational checker replays coefficient signs and boundary cases; the infinite-parameter theorem is established analytically, not by enumeration.
scientific.limitations: The result classifies positive endemic equilibria of the autonomous SVIR model only. It does not re-prove global stability, exclude Hopf bifurcation on the unique endemic branch, or generalize the no-backward-bifurcation statement to other vaccination models.

title: The subthreshold endemic branch in a 2024 SVIR model is algebraically empty
